pack.summary: This week, students are exploring the life cycles of animals and insects in Reading, focusing on 3-letter blends in Spelling, and learning about the 10 Commandments and the Great Commandment in Religion. In Math, the focus is on 2-digit addition with and without regrouping, while Grammar covers singular, plural, and compound nouns.
